name: Kaarya Facilities and Services
summary: Kaarya Facilities & Services Ltd. provides an array of property and facility management solutions to a broad spectrum of clients, including corporations, small and medium-sized enterprises, government bodies, and private households. The company's offerings span general property administration, specialized support like housekeeping, pest eradication, and gardening, as well as various engineering services. Founded on February 3, 2009, the firm operates from its main office in Mumbai, India.
